lines.trans: Kostya, take this, here is six hundred thousand for you.
Throw my daughter a proper wedding!
Do you hear me, a proper wedding!
You see for yourself that she wants this.
But she will never take money from me.
And how will I explain where I got this money?
What, am I supposed to make up stories for you too?
Tell her that you found it, stole it, or earned it!
No, that I earned it, she definitely will not believe.
There, the wheels are turning in your head, start thinking!
